args.reason: Every DoD item is part of inspecting the current merge-eligibility decision without merging: print merge-ok or the blocked conditions, with exit codes, and a test double asserting that no merge call happens under --dry-run. That is the first PRD goal and nothing more; there is no history storage or query. The dry run reuses the existing floor reads, so the floor logic stays the single source of truth, serving the second goal. No DoD capability goes beyond the declared goals, and no cited goal is left unserved.
